title: The canonical derived tensorator satisfies its defining tensor/counit square
statement: Let C and D be Grothendieck abelian braided closed monoidal categories with monoidal preadditivity and functorial flat resolutions. Let F:C→D be additive, preserve finite limits and colimits and flat objects, be a left adjoint, and carry a strong monoidal structure. Give LF the canonical residueDerivedMonoidal structure. For all homotopy complexes P,Q, δ_LF(QhP,QhQ) followed by γP⊗γQ and μ_Qh equals LF(μ_Qh(P,Q)) followed by γ(P⊗Q) and Qh(δ_Fh(P,Q)), where γ is leftDerivedFunctorCounit.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(5), Remark 6.8.15; formal tensor and counit normalization

proof.text: Unfold the canonical oplax tensor comparison in the derived monoidal construction. Its value is the existing leftDerivedTensorComparison. Apply leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_tensorHom.
